[[Tenshek's Shortbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Tenshek Roundbody]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[The Hidden City of Ahdashim]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:Lengthens [[Bleeding]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:[[Energy]] +5
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Ancient Shortbow]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[shortbow]]s:
**[[Composite Shortbow]] from collector [[Endah]] or crafter [[Ruricu]]
**[[Shortbow (weapon)|Shortbow]] from crafter [[Shichiroji]]
*[[Barbed]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following [[shortbow]]s:
**[[Composite Shortbow]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
